description: Shows or hides the Render Recorder control immediately left of Chat in the main header. Expand this row to configure automatic stop (0 means no time limit), data and DOM-change budgets, scope, decorative backgrounds, and browser signals. The header control starts and stops recording; this App Functions switch controls visibility only.

config.notes: These settings apply to the next capture. Set maximum capture time to 0 for no automatic stop; the data and DOM-change budgets still protect against runaway mutation volume.

settings.label: Automatic stop after
settings.hint: Seconds before automatic stop. Use 0 for no time limit.

settings.label: Maximum captured data
settings.hint: Combined baseline and DOM-difference budget for one capture.

settings.label: Maximum DOM changes
settings.hint: Stops mutation collection if a page produces excessive DOM churn.

settings.label: Capture scope
settings.hint: Chat only is lighter and is recommended for message ordering and loading issues.

settings.label: Decorative backgrounds
settings.hint: Include background DOM such as Stargaze/grid surfaces. Off by default; canvas and CSS animation frames are never sampled.

settings.label: UI lag signals
settings.hint: Record browser-wide long tasks that can explain visible stutter. Disable this if decorative workload timing is unwanted.

settings.label: JavaScript errors
settings.hint: Record uncaught errors and rejected promises during the test.

settings.label: Console warnings
settings.hint: Record browser console warnings and errors during the test.

settings.label: Network failures
settings.hint: Record failed and unusually slow browser requests.
